# [ColumnGroup()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}

::: {.doc-subject}

:::

::: {.doc-usage-source}
Usage

[Source](https://github.com/jeffgallini/dash-mantine-datatable/blob/main/dash_mantine_datatable\__init__.py#L360-L427){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION}
```python
ColumnGroup(group_id=None, /, *, columns=None, groups=None, **kwargs)
```
:::

## Description {.doc-description}

Build a grouped-header definition for `DataTable(groups=[...])`. Use this
when you want multiple header rows, such as a "Compensation" group above
salary and bonus columns.

## Parameters {.doc-parameters}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code>[group_id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default}</code>

:   Description: Stable identifier for the group. This is the id you use
    later with `table.group_columns(selector="compensation", ...)`.
    Example: `group_id="compensation"`.

<code>[columns]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[Any] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default}</code>

:   Description: Column references attached directly to this group. Each
    item may be an accessor string like `"salary"` or a full column
    dictionary.
    Example: `columns=["salary", "bonus"]`.

<code>[groups]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[dict[str, Any]] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default}</code>

:   Description: Nested child groups for multi-row grouped headers.
    Example: `groups=[ColumnGroup("cash", columns=["salary", "bonus"])]`.

<code>[title]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Visible header label for the group.
    Example: `title="Compensation"`.

<code>[style]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Inline style mapping applied to the group header cell.
    Example: `style={"textAlign": "center"}`.

<code>[headerStyle]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Header-specific style mapping forwarded to the frontend.
    Example: `headerStyle={"backgroundColor": "var(--mantine-color-gray-0)"}`.

<code>[textAlign]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Alignment hint for grouped-header content.
    Expected inputs: values accepted by Mantine/DataTable such as
    `'left'`, `'center'`, `'right'`.
    Example: `textAlign="center"`.
:::

## Returns {.doc-returns}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code> [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A grouped-header configuration dictionary.
:::

## Notes {.doc-notes}

Group dictionaries are plain Python objects, so they can be freely mixed
with `Column(...)` output and raw dictionaries in the same `groups` list.

## Examples {.doc-examples}

```python
>>> ColumnGroup("profile", title="Profile", columns=["name", "team"])
{'id': 'profile', 'columns': ['name', 'team'], 'title': 'Profile'}
```
